input.quote: 11.5 Special, Indirect, and Other Losses. EXCEPT (A) FOR FRAUD, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE, (B) FOR A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS UNDER [ARTICLE 9 OR SECTION 5.8], (C) AS PROVIDED UNDER [***] AND (D) TO THE EXTENT ANY SUCH DAMAGES ARE REQUIRED TO BE PAID TO A THIRD PARTY AS PART OF A CLAIM FOR WHICH A PARTY PROVIDES INDEMNIFICATION UNDER THIS ARTICLE 11, NEITHER PARTY NOR ANY OF ITS AFFILIATES SHALL BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, PUNITIVE OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES
input.rationale: Section 11.5 is the only limitation-of-liability provision. It is mutual and delivers the exclusion-of-damages limb (indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive and consequential), with carve-outs for fraud, willful misconduct and gross negligence, Article 9 confidentiality and Section 5.8, and indemnified Third Party Claims under Article 11. No aggregate monetary cap exists anywhere in the Agreement, so both Parties bear unlimited direct-damages exposure, failing the fallback's material 12-months'-fees cap. We propose one concise insertion at the preferred level: a mutual cap at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, with the existing (A)-(D) carve-outs plus data protection/security breaches and infringement of the other Party's IP left uncapped, and Customer's payment obligations expressly not damages for cap purposes.

ops.text: Aggregate Cap. Except for the matters described in clauses (A) through (D) of Section 11.5 and for a Party's breach of its data protection or security obligations or its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights, for which liability is not capped, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim by AbbVie under this Agreement and (b) USD 1,000,000. Customer's payment obligations under this Agreement, and all amounts due, are not damages for purposes of the foregoing cap.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement waives indirect and consequential damages but has no aggregate cap, so both Parties carry unlimited direct exposure; we add a mutual cap at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000. The existing clause (A)-(D) carve-outs stay uncapped, as do data protection and security breaches and infringement of the other Party's IP, and Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes.
proposal.summary: Insert a mutual aggregate liability cap (greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000) with the existing and added carve-outs uncapped.
